summary: Tested Embed Widget Behavior feature - configurable welcome message and default-open toggle. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Restored original Cardano welcome message and default_open=true after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Embed Widget Behavior feature fully tested. The Widget Behavior card on /admin/embed page allows configuring welcome_message (textarea) and default_open (toggle). The welcome message appears as the first bot bubble in the widget with markdown rendering (bold, bullets). The embed.js script supports data-welcome and data-open attributes and fetches config from /api/embed/config/{instance_id}.

features_tested.feature: Widget Behavior card on Embed Code page
features_tested.details: Card visible above Theme Configurator with Expand on Load toggle and Welcome Message textarea
Toggle visible, clickable, toggles between on/off states
Textarea visible, editable, pre-populated with saved Cardano greeting (377 chars)
Saves both welcome_message and default_open to backend, shows success toast
Preview iframe renders welcome message as bot bubble with markdown formatting
Widget at /widget?instance=<id>&mode=popup shows welcome message as first bot message with bold text and bullet points
Script contains attr('welcome') and attr('open') support, fetches config from /api/embed/config/{instance_id}
Accepts and saves welcome_message (string) and default_open (boolean)
